title: Kitten Totem (Ocelot)
description: This RP changes the Totem to the Baby Ocelot.
body: This Resource Pack changes the Totem to the Baby Ocelot. The Totem doesn't changes then the Original Baby Ocelot changes from Resource Packs. It changes the Totem Texture and Model, so please don't use Resource Packs on Top of these, that changes the Texture of the Totem... Here are all [Kitten Totem Resource Packs](https://modrinth.com/collection/UuL4BZ7D).
